proof_body:
by
  intro p x hp h
  have hpi : Prime (p : ℤ) := Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.1 hp
  have h1 : (p : ℤ) ∣ (x - 1) * (x + 1) := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Int.modEq_iff_dvd.1 h.symm
    exact ⟨k, by rw [← hk]; ring⟩
  rcases hpi.dvd_or_dvd h1 with h2 | h2
  · exact Or.inl (Int.modEq_iff_dvd.2 h2).symm
  · exact Or.inr (Int.modEq_iff_dvd.2 (by simpa using h2)).symm
target_source: ∀ (p : ℕ) (x : ℤ), Nat.Prime p → x ^ 2 ≡ 1 [ZMOD p] → x ≡ 1 [ZMOD p] ∨ x ≡ -1 [ZMOD p]
